title: JKSSB MTS / Class-IV & Sanitation Worker Recruitment 2026 - 2863 Posts
qualificationText: MTS: Matric (10th) to 10+2. Sanitation Worker: 8th Pass to 10+2
salary: Pay Level SL1: Rs 14,800 - Rs 47,100 per month
shortInfo: JKSSB has invited online applications for 2,863 Class-IV (MTS) and Sanitation Worker posts across UT, Divisional and District cadres under Advertisement No. 09 of 2026. The last date has been extended to 27 November 2026. Only J&K domicile holders can apply.
eligibilityNotes:
Must be a Domicile holder of the Union Territory of J&K with a valid Domicile Certificate on or before the cut-off date.
Qualification must match the post: MTS needs Matric (10th) to 10+2; Sanitation Worker needs 8th Pass to 10+2. Other qualifications are not eligible.
Age is counted as on 01.01.2026. Upper limit: 40 years (OM), 43 years (SC, ST-1, ST-2, OBC, RBA, ALC/IB, EWS), 42 years (PwBD).
Only one application per item number is allowed. Multiple applications for the same item number lead to cancellation.
selection:
Objective type written test (MCQ, English only). Negative marking: one-fourth of the marks of each wrong answer is deducted.
Final merit = written test marks + additional weightage, then document verification.
UT Cadre: written 85 + no family member in govt service 5 + widow/divorced/orphan girl 5 + casual worker (5+ years) 5 = 100.
Divisional Cadre: written 80 + home division 5 + the three 5-mark claims = 100.
District Cadre: written 75 + home district 10 + the three 5-mark claims = 100.
Cadre and department are allocated on merit-cum-preference basis.
howToApply:
Visit www.jkssb.nic.in once the application window opens
Register or log in on the online portal
Fill in personal, educational and category details carefully
Upload live photograph and signature (10 KB to 20 KB each)
Pay the fee online (Net Banking, Credit Card or Debit Card)
Review everything, then submit. No corrections are allowed after submission
Save and print the application for document verification
documents:
Original and self-attested copies of the online application and all certificates
Valid Domicile Certificate (J&K)
Educational certificates (Matric / 8th / 10+2 as applicable)
Category / reservation certificate, if applicable
Two recent passport-size colour photographs (not older than 6 months) and a valid photo ID
Weightage certificates (no government family member, widow/divorced/orphan, or casual-worker status), if claimed

ageRelax.category: SC / ST / OBC / RBA / ALC-IB / EWS

ageRelax.relaxation: Military service deducted from age; allowed up to 3 years above the limit

title: J&K Bank Recruitment 2026 - 1053 Banking Associate & Probationary Officer Posts
qualificationText: Graduation in any discipline (degree or marksheet needed by 26-11-2026)
salary: BA: Rs 24,050 basic. PO: Rs 48,480 basic
shortInfo: J&K Bank has released two notifications for 1,053 posts: 1,033 Banking Associate posts (J&K UT domicile) and 20 Probationary Officer posts (Ladakh UT domicile). Both use the same application and fee window, which closes on 26 November 2026.
eligibilityNotes:
Banking Associate: J&K UT domicile with a valid domicile certificate.
Probationary Officer: Ladakh UT domicile.
Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognised university. Final-year students who will not finish by 26-11-2026 are not eligible. CGPA/OGPA must be converted to a percentage as per the university formula.
Age: 20 to 30 years as on 01.01.2026, before relaxation.
Banking Associate reservation: SC 8%, ST 10% (existing) + 10% (newly added), OBC 8%, ALC/IB 4%, RBA 10%, EWS 10%, Ex-Servicemen 6% and PwBD 4% (horizontal).
Probationary Officer (Ladakh) reservation: SC 1%, ST 80%, residents of areas adjoining ALC 4%, EWS 10%, PwBD 4% (horizontal).
A category certificate is needed at online registration if you claim reservation.
selection:
Banking Associate: one online exam conducted by IBPS (100 questions, 100 marks, 60 minutes, English, negative marking 1/4), then provisional selection and document verification. No interview. Minimum qualifying marks: 40% (General) and 35% (reserved). Former J&K Bank apprentices with J&K domicile get 2.5 extra marks.
Probationary Officer: Preliminary online exam, Main exam (objective + descriptive essay/comprehension), then a 100-mark interview. Final merit = 80% Main + 20% Interview. Preliminary marks are used only for shortlisting.
howToApply:
Visit the official website jkb.bank.in (Careers section) from 7 November 2026
Register and log in
Fill in the online form, including graduation percentage
Upload photograph, signature and other documents as asked
Pay the fee online (Debit / Credit Card, Net Banking, IMPS or wallet)
Submit the application and save a printout
documents:
Graduation degree certificate or marksheet (valid by 26-11-2026)
Valid domicile certificate: J&K UT for Banking Associate, Ladakh UT for Probationary Officer
Category certificate, if claiming reservation (needed at registration)
Photo ID proof and a recent photograph and signature

title: RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026 - 1265 Posts (CEN 08/2026)
qualificationText: Bachelor's Degree from a recognised university (must be completed by 25-11-2026)
shortInfo: Indian Railways, through the Railway Recruitment Boards, has opened online applications for 1,265 Station Master posts under CEN 08/2026. Vacancies were corrected from 1,215 to 1,265 by Corrigendum No. 1 dated 27-10-2026. Apply at rrbapply.gov.in by 25 November 2026 (11:59 PM). You can apply to only one RRB.
eligibilityNotes:
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent from a recognised university, completed by 25-11-2026. Candidates awaiting final results are not eligible.
Age: 20 to 33 years as on 01-01-2027. Relaxation: OBC-NCL 3 years, SC/ST 5 years, and other government rules.
Must meet the A-2 medical standard for Station Master.
Candidates must apply to only one RRB. Multiple applications may lead to rejection.
selection:
Computer Based Test (CBT): 100 questions, 100 marks, 120 minutes. Negative marking: 1/3 mark per wrong answer.
CBT sections: Basic Science, Mathematical & Analytical Capability (60 Q), Logical Capability (20 Q), Mental Reasoning (20 Q).
Then Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT), document verification and medical examination.
Final merit: 70% CBT + 30% CBAT.
howToApply:
Visit rrbapply.gov.in
Click Create an Account (new) or Already Have an Account (login)
Complete account verification and enter personal details
Fill in educational qualification and category details
Select the Railway Recruitment Board and your preferences carefully
Upload live photograph, signature and documents as the portal asks
Review all details and submit
Pay the exam fee online
Download and print the application form
documents:
Live photograph and signature, as per portal instructions
Bachelor's degree / marksheets
Category or concession certificate, if claimed
Registered mobile number and email ID for login and OTP

title: Indian Bank 1500 Apprentices Online Form 2026
shortInfo: Indian Bank has invited online applications for 1,500 apprentices for FY 2026-27 under the Apprentices Act, with 12 months of on-the-job training across India.
eligibilityNotes:
Graduate in any discipline, passed between 1 Apr 2022 and 1 Nov 2026.
Not eligible: candidates who have already done an apprenticeship, or have one year or more of work experience after qualification.
selection: Online written test (100 marks, 60 minutes), Local Language Proficiency Test, document verification and medical fitness.
howToApply:
Register on the NATS 2.0 portal and complete your profile
Save your NATS Enrolment ID
Open the Apply Online link and register as a new user
Fill personal, graduation and category details
Choose one State/UT and up to three districts
Upload photo, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration
Preview, submit and pay the fee online
Save a printout of the application
documents:
Graduation certificate and marksheets
Date of birth and identity proof
NATS Enrolment ID
Photo, signature, thumb impression, handwritten declaration
Category / PwBD certificate if applicable
